name: What Do We Want
aka: What Do We Want? When Do We Want It?
look: Four panels in a 2x2 grid of crude drawings. On the left, a figure with a pink shirt, a yellow tuft of hair and a huge open mouth raises one arm and waves a broom against a yellow burst. On the right, three identical figures raise their arms and shout. Both rows repeat.
use: A protest chant in four beats. The leader asks "What do we want?", the crowd shouts a demand, the leader asks "When do we want it?", and the crowd's final answer delivers a twist that undercuts the whole demand.
slots: the crowd's answer, usually a twist (bottom right)
describe: crude drawing of a leader with a broom shouting at a crowd
four panel protest chant with a crowd yelling back
cartoon person with pink shirt yelling on yellow burst background
three identical cartoon people raising their arms and shouting
leader asks a question and followers answer in unison
origin: Reuses the broom-waving character from Allie Brosh's webcomic Hyperbole and a Half, the same drawing behind X All the Y.
